finalists.label: Brown Tumor
finalists.why: It has specific evidence of a large tumor on the distal part of the right fourth finger with brown coloration of osteolytic cysts.

finalists.label: Bone tumor
finalists.why: It is a general term that fits the large tumor on the distal part of the right fourth finger but lacks specific details found in Brown Tumor.

finalists.label: Hyperparathyroidism-Jaw Tumor Syndrome
finalists.why: It connects primary hyperparathyroidism with the presence of a tumor but is less specific to the findings than Brown Tumor.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a large tumor on the distal part of the right fourth finger with specific histopathological features such as fibrous tissue, woven bone, and brown coloration of osteolytic cysts uniquely supports Brown Tumor.
